verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a documented public REST Management API (supabase-docs-28), an OpenAPI spec confirmed live via probe (supabase-probe-3), a CLI for scripted/agentic workflows (supabase-docs-5/32, supabase-probe-rt-1), and an official MCP server (supabase-docs-1, supabase-probe-4, supabase-probe-rt-2) plus machine-discoverable agent-skills catalog (supabase-probe-rt-3) — all giving AI agents multiple documented, verified ways to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of the Management API itself being used by agents beyond Supabase's own MCP/CLI tooling.
